description: Minimal staggered-to-eclipsed torsional rotation sample for SCAN smoke tests.
ui_note: Recommended for SCAN mode. The product is an eclipsed high-energy conformer.

reference_values.note: Classic ethane staggered-to-eclipsed torsional barrier; not a thermal DeltaG_activation.

pitzer_1945_jcp.citation: K. S. Pitzer, Theory of the Origin of the Internal Rotation Barrier in Ethane, J. Chem. Phys. 1945, 43, S217.

notes: This is an intentionally tiny SCAN smoke test.
Product is the eclipsed high-energy conformer rather than a minimum.
The _scan suffix means SCAN is the preferred initial-path mode, not the only supported mode.
